key_insight: A semiclassical molecular dynamics framework models EIT cooling in Penning-trap ion crystals, including efficient axial-mode cooling in simulated 3D crystals with up to 500 ions.
engineering_relevance: The framework can guide cooling-protocol optimization for trapped-ion quantum sensing and quantum information experiments.
method: Evolve internal quantum states alongside classical ion motion to calculate instantaneous EIT laser forces.
Analyze planar drumhead-mode cooling with planar ion motion and finite laser beam width.
Engineer 3D mode spectra to enable sympathetic cooling of low-frequency E×B modes.
evidence_signal: The authors validate single-ion cooling rates against fully quantum simulations and demonstrate axial-mode cooling numerically in 3D crystals containing up to 500 ions.
watch_item: Single-ion validation does not establish the semiclassical model’s accuracy for all many-ion regimes or experimental conditions.
paper_title: Semiclassical molecular dynamics simulations of electromagnetically induced transparency cooling of 2D and 3D ion crystals in a Penning trap
